columns.name: dataset
columns.definition: Dataset name

columns.name: participant_id
columns.definition: WESAD subject folder id (S2..S17)

columns.name: window_id
columns.definition: Stable id '<dataset>:<participant>:w<index>'

columns.name: window_index
columns.definition: 0-based index of the window on the t=0-anchored grid

columns.name: start_seconds
columns.definition: Window start on the synchronised pickle timeline, inclusive

columns.name: end_seconds
columns.definition: Window end, exclusive

columns.name: start_label_sample
columns.definition: First 700-Hz label sample index (inclusive)

columns.name: end_label_sample
columns.definition: Label sample index end (exclusive)

columns.name: acc_start_sample
columns.definition: First wrist ACC sample (32 Hz), inclusive

columns.name: acc_end_sample
columns.definition: Wrist ACC sample end, exclusive

columns.name: bvp_start_sample
columns.definition: First wrist BVP sample (64 Hz), inclusive

columns.name: bvp_end_sample
columns.definition: Wrist BVP sample end, exclusive

columns.name: eda_start_sample
columns.definition: First wrist EDA sample (4 Hz), inclusive

columns.name: eda_end_sample
columns.definition: Wrist EDA sample end, exclusive

columns.name: temp_start_sample
columns.definition: First wrist TEMP sample (4 Hz), inclusive

columns.name: temp_end_sample
columns.definition: Wrist TEMP sample end, exclusive

columns.name: source_file
columns.definition: Release-relative pickle path the window was derived from

columns.name: source_sha256
columns.definition: SHA-256 of that pickle as recorded in the raw checksum baseline

columns.name: raw_label_codes_present
columns.definition: Sorted raw label codes occurring in the window, comma-joined

columns.name: n_label_samples
columns.definition: Number of 700-Hz label samples in the window (42000 for a complete 60-s window)

columns.name: is_label_homogeneous
columns.definition: True if exactly one raw code covers the whole window

columns.name: homogeneous_raw_label
columns.definition: The single raw code if homogeneous

columns.name: condition_name
columns.definition: Readme name of the homogeneous code, or 'mixed'

columns.name: binary_eligible
columns.definition: True only if homogeneous raw code 1 (baseline reference) or 2 (protocol-stress reference)

columns.name: analysis_label
columns.definition: 0 = baseline reference, 1 = protocol-stress reference; null otherwise. Never majority-voted.

columns.name: ineligibility_reason
columns.definition: Why binary_eligible is False ('' if eligible)

columns.name: q_acc_n_samples
columns.definition: Samples of ACC actually in the window

columns.name: q_acc_count_ok
columns.definition: n_samples == expected native count (1920 for 60 s)

columns.name: q_acc_finite_fraction
columns.definition: Fraction of finite samples

columns.name: q_acc_constant
columns.definition: True if the signal range within the window is below constant_eps

columns.name: q_bvp_n_samples
columns.definition: Samples of BVP actually in the window

columns.name: q_bvp_count_ok
columns.definition: n_samples == expected native count (3840 for 60 s)

columns.name: q_bvp_finite_fraction
columns.definition: Fraction of finite samples

columns.name: q_bvp_constant
columns.definition: True if the signal range within the window is below constant_eps

columns.name: q_eda_n_samples
columns.definition: Samples of EDA actually in the window

columns.name: q_eda_count_ok
columns.definition: n_samples == expected native count (240 for 60 s)

columns.name: q_eda_finite_fraction
columns.definition: Fraction of finite samples

columns.name: q_eda_constant
columns.definition: True if the signal range within the window is below constant_eps

columns.name: q_temp_n_samples
columns.definition: Samples of TEMP actually in the window

columns.name: q_temp_count_ok
columns.definition: n_samples == expected native count (240 for 60 s)

columns.name: q_temp_finite_fraction
columns.definition: Fraction of finite samples

columns.name: q_temp_constant
columns.definition: True if the signal range within the window is below constant_eps

columns.name: q_acc_clipped
columns.definition: Any |raw count| >= clip threshold (provisional; E4 range is +-2 g = +-128 counts)

columns.name: q_eda_below_plausible
columns.definition: Any EDA sample below eda_min_plausible_us (provisional threshold)

columns.name: q_temp_out_of_range
columns.definition: Any TEMP sample outside temp_plausible_range_c (provisional)

columns.name: q_eda_decomposition_ok
columns.definition: Recording-level tonic/phasic decomposition succeeded for this participant

columns.name: q_bvp_pulse_detection_ok
columns.definition: Recording-level pulse-peak detection ran for this participant

columns.name: q_bvp_hr_available
columns.definition: Enough plausible beats in the window for HR summaries (>= min_beats_for_hr and coverage >= min_beat_coverage)

columns.name: q_feature_error
columns.definition: Exception text if any feature family failed for this window ('' otherwise)

columns.name: q_structural_ok
columns.definition: All modality counts ok, all finite, no constant signal, no feature error. NOT a physiological-credibility claim.
